blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.title: Senior Editor, People Managing People
blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.description: About People Managing People: People Managing People helps executives and people leaders build AI-enabled, human-centered organizations that thrive. We provide peer-driven insights, practical frameworks, operational playbooks, and community-powered experiences focused on HR strategy, AI in the workplace, talent and recruitment, employee retention and culture, workforce management, and modern people leadership. Our audience includes CHROs, chief people officers, HR and people leaders, talent and recruiting leaders, operations executives, and senior people practitioners looking for practical insight, trustworthy guidance, and meaningful professional connection. About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Editor to help build People Managing People into a trusted, community-powered media brand for people leaders and HR professionals. This role is responsible for growing loyal, engaged people leadership and HR audiences through authoritative, practitioner-led editorial experiences across articles, newsletters, social, video, podcasts, livestreams, events, and strategic partnerships. This is not a traditional editing role focused only on publishing content. It is an audience growth and editorial leadership role centered on creating serious-fun, decision-support content that helps people leaders make better decisions, build healthier cultures, adopt AI-enabled ways of working, strengthen their teams, and navigate the changing realities of modern people leadership. You will help shape the voice, authority, growth, and audience experience of the brand. Your work should increase subscriber growth, newsletter engagement, return audience behavior, topical authority, and trust with people leaders and HR professionals. Who You Are: You understand how to create editorial brands that professionals actively trust, return to, and recommend. You are deeply curious about how people leaders and HR professionals operate, lead teams, adopt AI-enabled workflows, build culture, develop talent, and navigate organizational complexity. You know how to turn practitioner insight into useful editorial experiences that feel credible, clear, visual, engaging, and worth sharing. You are not just a writer or editor. You are a builder of audience systems, community loops, and repeat engagement. You think beyond articles and understand that modern editorial engagement happens across newsletters, video, podcasts, social, community discussions, livestreams, events, partnerships, search, and AI discovery experiences. You are comfortable experimenting with formats, workflows, packaging, distribution strategies, and audience experiences to improve performance over time. You care about usefulness, clarity, audience trust, and measurable impact. What You’ll Be Doing: 1. Build engaged, community-powered editorial experiences You will create serious-fun, expert-driven editorial and audience experiences that grow subscribers, increase newsletter engagement, and build loyal engineering, AI, and technology leadership audiences. Create, assign, edit, write, and publish editorial content across articles, newsletters, social, short-form video, narrative video, podcasts, livestreams, events, and community formats Develop content informed by real practitioner insight, including interviews, contributor conversations, engineering communities, surveys, Q&As, and social listening Create audience experiences focused on engineering leadership, AI adoption, scalability, platform reliability, developer productivity, infrastructure, security, and modern technology execution Help program and support webinars, livestreams, roundtables, podcasts, and editorial event experiences Repurpose editorial IP into newsletter blocks, social content, video clips, lead magnets, reports, and community assets Ensure editorial output reflects the publication’s tone, usefulness, authority, and audience relevance Continuously identify opportunities to increase audience participation, contribution, sharing,

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:e0.title: Process Technician
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:e0.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at Avant Organics! Avant Organics uses the art of biotechnology to redefine traditional organic chemistry and create sustainable products for its customers in multiple industries. Whether manufacturing flavors and fragrances to be used in foods or medicines or creating other components used in our everyday life – Avant Organics offers its customers fresh solutions that meet even the toughest regulatory standards. The Avant Organics Process Technician is a hybrid role that blends hands-on process operation with proactive mechanical and electrical maintenance. This role works closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, perform preventative maintenance, and support the commissioning of new systems as we scale. In our fast-paced startup environment, the Process Technician will help shape operational standards, contribute to process improvements, and build the technical foundation for sustainable growth. This role offers multiple pathways for advancement, depending on strengths and interests. We aren't looking for someone to run the process - we're looking for someone to grow with it.
responsibilities: Process Monitoring & Control
Operate and monitor chemical processing equipment such as reactors, mixers, pumps, and distillation units
Adjust temperature, pressure, flow rates, and other parameters to maintain optimal production conditions.
Quality Assurance
Conduct tests and inspections to ensure products meet required specifications.
Collect and analyze samples during production for consistency and compliance.
Equipment Maintenance
Perform routine checks and basic maintenance on machinery.
Perform scheduled inspections and servicing of pumps, valves, compressors, and instrumentation to prevent breakdowns.
Maintain lubrication schedules and replace worn components before failure.
Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and control system issues in real time.
Repair or replace faulty equipment parts with minimal disruption to production.
Safety & Compliance
Follow strict safety protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Participate in safety training and ensure compliance with environmental and regulatory standards.
Ensure all maintenance work complies with safety regulations and lockout/tagout procedures.
Participate in hazard assessments and equipment risk evaluations.
Documentation & Reporting
Record operational data, batch records, and test results.
Maintain accurate logs for audits and continuous improvement efforts.
Flexibility & Adaptability
Quickly adapt to evolving processes and technologies.
Support pilot runs and scale-up activities from lab to full production.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with R&D, operations, and quality teams to develop and refine new products.
Provide feedback on process feasibility and scalability.
Continuous Learning
Stay updated on new equipment, automation tools, and chemical handling techniques.
Help establish SOPs and training materials for future hires.
Additional Duties and Responsibilities
This role is responsible for food safety and following good manufacturing practices and reporting unsafe conditions to supervisors
Additional duties as assigned by leadership
qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent, required. College degree in Math, Biology, or Chemistry, preferred.
Post-secondary certificate in agriculture or natural resources, precision production or another related area, preferred.
A background in maintenance or a laboratory setting preferred.
Ability to work in a team-driven environment with a collaborative and proactive attitude required.
High degree of organizational skills, to be able to document processes and results, required.
Mechanically inclined, knowledgeable of machines and tools, required.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f26.title: Kitchen Assistant (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f26.team: 140 - Crocker Park - Sur La Table, 218 Main Street, Westlake, OH 44145
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f26.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:b52ca5c8-.title: Lifecycle Journey Manager, Retention
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:b52ca5c8-.description: About Gen At Gen (NASDAQ: GEN), an S&P 500 company, we strive to give everyone the power to explore our shared digital world freely and safely. We help shape the digital world to be a freer, fairer, and safer place through the application of science, technology, and human ingenuity, and we are looking for people who share our passion for contributing to a better online world. Gen safeguards hundreds of millions of people worldwide across Cybersecurity, Identity, and Financial Wellness - including through MoneyLion, our financial-wellness platform that helps people take control of their money and build a healthier financial life. About the team and the role You’ll be the dedicated owner of the Retention stage of MoneyLion’s user journey - the engine that turns a first monetization moment into a durable, repeat relationship. As a senior lifecycle journey manager, you own retention strategy, retention KPIs, and the end-to-end journeys that keep customers active and engaged across their lifecycle. You’ll define the retention scoring and intervention logic that powers our AI decisioning, and partner with Product, Data, and Martech to prove incremental impact on retention and LTV. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets definitions and standards others adopt, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and shipping journeys. What you’ll do • Own end-to-end retention strategy and the primary KPI - Retention Rate, repeat monetization moments, D30/Dn retention, and churn. • Define retention and churn scoring, triggers, and intervention logic; set the signals and guardrails the decisioning stack (Hightouch) acts on. • Design reactivation, win-back, and engagement journeys, and build direct-deposit and habit stickiness. • Build and launch in Iterable - increasingly via AI decisioning - owning QA, frequency, and suppressions. • Design holdouts and read incrementality with Analytics to prove true retention lift, distinguishing it from compounded-cycle artifacts. • Shape the loyalty and premium experience in partnership with PMM and Product. • Own the numbers and the retention narrative for leadership, surfacing insights and clear next steps. • Direct and supervise the AI agents that execute retention programs, and set their guardrails. What you’ll bring • 7–10+ years in lifecycle / CRM / retention marketing for a digital product or subscription business, with a deep retention and churn focus. • A track record owning retention strategy and personally shipping journeys in Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar. • Advanced data literacy - survival / cohort analysis, incrementality, and experimentation design. • Experience building triggered, always-on retention programs (onboarding, win-back, reactivation, loyalty). • Comfort defining inputs to ML decisioning (churn scoring, next-best-action) and interpreting model outputs. • Senior cross-functional leadership - influence without authority and keep stakeholders aligned and moving. • Excellent communication; able to set definitions and measurement standards the wider team adopts. • A bias toward ownership and action. Nice to have • Experience in fintech, subscription, or consumer products. • Familiarity with AIDs, Hightouch, or other predictive decisioning platforms. What we offer • Competitive salary with a performance-based bonus scheme (up to 15%) • Flexible working hours with hybrid / home-office options • The chance to join a major global tech company listed on the S&P 500 • A meaningful learning & development budget and clear career growth • Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits • Modern equipment (Mac/Windows) for work and personal use • Employee Stock Purchase Plan Location: NYC Office (Onsite 3 days per week) The annual base salary for this position is expected to be between $160,000 and $185,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes 401(k) match, health insurance options, disability cover

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d40b079-a47f-.title: Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d40b079-a47f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems based in Ireland. This is a senior culinary leadership role focused on building the systems that make food quality, safety, and consistency scalable across multiple locations. You will assess culinary operations, identify urgent product and quality issues, and establish practical standards that can withstand growth and team turnover. The role combines culinary expertise with operational discipline, covering recipes, specifications, food safety, menu performance, training, suppliers, and food economics. Rather than managing daily kitchen execution, you will provide remote leadership through on-site culinary leaders and location teams. You will use data and modern technology to diagnose problems, improve processes, and make informed decisions about products and menus. Success will require balancing exacting culinary standards with commercial realities such as food cost, waste, labor, and margin. This is an opportunity to build durable culinary infrastructure and develop leaders across a distributed operation. Assess the current state of products, menus, recipes, processes, and suppliers using operational data, reports, and remote evidence to identify quality, consistency, and efficiency gaps. Diagnose taste, consistency, product, and food-safety issues and direct corrective actions through on-site Head Chefs and location teams. Develop controlled recipes, specifications, preparation standards, and operating procedures with clear tolerances, documentation, and version control. Lead menu engineering initiatives by analyzing product performance and determining which offerings should be improved, repositioned, or discontinued. Establish robust food-safety, quality assurance, and traceability controls, including root-cause analysis and corrective actions when failures occur. Recruit, train, coach, and develop culinary leaders across multiple locations, creating consistent standards and strengthening leadership capabilities remotely. Establish systems that allow culinary quality to remain consistent despite team turnover, geographic distance, and operational growth. Own the culinary drivers of food cost, yield, waste, labor efficiency, and margin, identifying opportunities to improve commercial performance without compromising quality. Use AI, data, and other technology tools to support culinary analysis, operational decision-making, documentation, training, and continuous improvement. Partner with on-site culinary leadership to translate strategic standards into practical execution and ensure accountability across locations. Requirements Significant senior-level culinary leadership experience within complex, multi-location food service, restaurant, hospitality, or related environments. Demonstrated ability to diagnose product and quality problems, restore consistency, and build repeatable culinary systems rather than relying solely on individual expertise. Experience leading and directing kitchen execution remotely through on-site culinary leaders and distributed teams. Strong understanding of food cost, yield management, waste reduction, labor economics, and the relationship between culinary decisions and profitability. Proven experience with food safety, quality assurance, traceability, and root-cause analysis. Strong practical knowledge of recipe development, food specifications, menu engineering, culinary standards, and process documentation. Advanced, practical use of AI and data tools to support culinary management, operational analysis, and decision-making. Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence teams and maintain high standards without being physically present. Ability to balance culinary excellence with commercial judgment, operational realities, and business objectives. Experience managing multiple concepts, cuisine

jobgether-jobgether:lever:95ef5656-4a8b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Professional Services Operations Coordinator based in the United States. This role supports the operational engine behind successful Professional Services delivery in a fast-paced SaaS environment. You’ll coordinate workflows across Sales, Implementation, Finance, RevOps, and Customer Success to keep projects moving smoothly. The position combines project coordination, systems administration, reporting, data quality, and process improvement. You’ll help ensure customer handoffs are complete, operational systems remain accurate, and delivery teams have the information they need to succeed. The role also offers opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and integrations to reduce manual work and improve efficiency. Success requires strong organization, attention to detail, autonomy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across teams. This is a fully remote opportunity with meaningful exposure to operational strategy, technology, and business performance. Coordinate cross-functional delivery workflows across Sales, Implementation, Finance, RevOps, and related teams, including project routing, provisioning, and customer transitions. Manage sales-to-implementation handoffs, verifying contractual requirements, deliverables, and operational readiness before projects begin. Coordinate implementation-to-Customer Success handoffs, reviewing project closeout activities to ensure information and documentation are complete and consistent. Administer Professional Services systems and tools, including project provisioning, templates, user permissions, data maintenance, and archiving. Prepare recurring reports and dashboards covering delivery performance, capacity, utilization, backlog, project health, and other operational KPIs. Maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational playbooks to promote consistent execution across the organization. Support financial and operational tracking by maintaining accurate metrics and KPI data. Identify opportunities to improve workflows through AI-enabled tools, automation, integrations, and other technology solutions. Audit project and operational data, identify discrepancies, and coordinate timely corrections to maintain data integrity and compliance with established processes. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in Professional Services Operations, Delivery Operations, Project Coordination, or a comparable operational role, preferably within a SaaS or technology organization. Strong experience working with CRM and project management platforms, particularly Salesforce, Toggl, Asana, and/or Professional Services Automation (PSA) systems. Proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including capacity tracking, SLA reporting, dashboards, and operational reporting. Demonstrated ability to manage recurring operational responsibilities independently while maintaining high standards of data accuracy and meeting deadlines. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple business functions. Proven ability to coordinate several cross-functional initiatives simultaneously while remaining organized, detail-oriented, and process-focused. Experience producing operational reports and maintaining reliable data that supports leadership decision-making. A proactive, self-starting mindset and willingness to identify process improvements rather than simply follow existing workflows. Comfort working in a technology-driven environment and using automation or AI tools to improve operational efficiency is highly valuable. Benefits: Annual salary range of $78,026–$98,000 , with starting compensation determined by factors including experience, education, certifications, technical and non-technical skills, market conditions, and business expertise. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d24854d9-3c84-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Engineering Manager based in France. Lead a critical engineering area within a fast-growing global technology organization and help raise the bar for product development. You’ll combine deep engineering judgment with people leadership, strategic thinking, and a strong sense of ownership. Working closely with Product and Design, you’ll shape solutions early, bring clarity to complex challenges, and guide teams toward sustainable execution. You’ll remain connected to the technical work while empowering engineers to make strong decisions and deliver with confidence. The role offers broad influence over engineering standards, architecture, delivery practices, and long-term product outcomes. You’ll operate in a globally distributed, inclusive environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and practical execution. This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and the teams behind products serving a global customer base. Lead and develop an engineering team by providing clear direction, context, coaching, feedback, and support for individual and collective growth. Partner closely with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery to shape effective solutions and align technical possibilities with customer and business needs. Own delivery from problem definition through execution, ensuring priorities, responsibilities, dependencies, and expected outcomes remain clear. Establish predictable and sustainable execution through thoughtful planning, realistic expectations, transparent progress tracking, and proactive risk management. Provide technical leadership across complex products and systems, making informed architectural and engineering decisions while remaining close to the work. Maintain high standards for engineering quality, scalability, reliability, maintainability, testing, and continuous delivery. Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, processes, collaboration, and delivery across the wider organization. Help engineers work effectively with modern development technologies, including AI-assisted tools and LLM-based coding assistants. Contribute strategic engineering experience and leadership to broader organizational initiatives and help create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. Requirements: Significant experience leading engineering teams within a product-focused technology organization. Proven track record of delivering complex products, platforms, or systems in fast-moving environments. Strong technical judgment and the ability to participate confidently in both engineering and product discussions. Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, establish clarity, and turn complex problems into actionable plans. Strong experience partnering with Product and Design to shape solutions, priorities, and product direction. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear context, align diverse stakeholders, and communicate effectively at all levels. Strong ownership mindset combined with a practical, execution-oriented approach to leadership. Experience working with modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices is highly valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as PHP/Symfony, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Helm is advantageous. Understanding of distributed architectures, scalable data processing, observability, automated testing, CI/CD, continuous delivery, and A/B testing is a plus. Experience using LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to improve implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and software quality is beneficial. Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed environment and collaborating asynchronously across functions and locations. Benefits: Fully remote position available within
